scope: A DM held while its sender was pending is counted after Confirm even when Confirm interleaves with its retain write.
files_to_modify: app/src/lib/directMessageNotifications.ts (register each held DM's write in the tick of the pending check)
app/src/lib/unreadStore.ts (trackHeldDirectMessageWrite; the confirm recount waits for held writes and adds live bumps during the call to max(pre, stored), with per-call trackers)
docs/behavior/contacts-and-direct-messages.md, docs/behavior/notifications-and-unread.md (stale: held DMs count on Confirm)

behavior.race: Confirm during a held DM's write → the recount waits for the write; DMs arriving live during the recount are added, not maxed; no double count.
behavior.unchanged: While still pending: retained, not counted. Confirmed before arrival: counted live, not retained.

tests: Unit: watcher registration timing (both kinds), failed write settles, confirmed peer registers none; real-store recount interleavings (Codex scenario, overlapping recounts, read during recount)
non_goals: Changing the e2e spec's wait (the race is fixed in product code)
